prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 研发中心季度例会签到表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "姓名" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 2: header "部门" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 3: header "签到时间" · longest unbreakable word 42px · one-line width 62px
  col 4: header "签退时间" · longest unbreakable word 39px · one-line width 62px
  col 5: header "备注" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 429px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"记录研发中心季度例会的参会人员、所属部门、签到签退时间及特殊情况。","reading":"按行核对个人出勤情况，纵向查看部门和时间；备注用于解释缺席签退或迟到等情况。较长备注形成的行高可容纳同一行部门名称的换行。","groups":["姓名与部门共同识别参会人员及其归属。","签到时间与签退时间是一对对应字段，宜采用相同宽度以便比较。","备注是补充说明，内容长度变化较大。"],"keep_intact":["姓名","签到和签退的具体时间","表示无记录的破折号"],"may_wrap":["部门名称可在汉字之间换行。","签到时间和签退时间的表头可换行。","备注可按语义自然换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [67, 77, 63, 63, 89] · table 360×733px · row heights [60, 60, 176, 83, 60, 60, 176, 60] · column headers wrapped 2/5 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [60, 69, 81, 81, 68] · table 360×849px · row heights [60, 60, 246, 83, 60, 60, 222, 60] · column headers wrapped 2/5 · tallest cell 10 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [67, 63, 63, 63, 103] · table 360×756px · row heights [60, 83, 153, 83, 83, 83, 129, 83] · column headers wrapped 2/5 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"姓名和具体时间保持完整；签到、签退两列等宽，便于横向核对。部门多为两行，简单记录的行高也较一致。","problems":"长备注被挤成较窄的竖向文字块，阅读停顿频繁；时间表头分成两行。","cause":"备注列89px，仅有68px文本宽度；两列时间各63px，足以容纳具体时间，却不足以容纳完整表头。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"时间列成对等宽，具体时间与无记录符号清楚，部门名称多数保持两行。","problems":"多个姓名被拆开，影响逐行识别；长备注形成很高的文字块，拉大行距，使同一行其他字段远离下一条记录。时间表头仍然换行。","cause":"姓名列60px仅有39px文本宽度，容不下三个汉字的姓名；备注列68px仅有47px文本宽度。时间列各81px占用了本可分给姓名和备注的空间，却仍不足以容纳完整表头。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"姓名与具体时间完整，时间列等宽；103px的备注列让长说明比其他两版更容易阅读，长备注行也较低。","problems":"部门几乎都分成三行，即使备注为空也撑高了多数数据行，纵向扫描显得零碎；时间表头仍分成两行。","cause":"部门列63px仅有42px文本宽度，通常每行只能容纳两个汉字；时间列各63px不足以容纳完整表头。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced","widths":[67,73,63,63,93],"change":"在r0A基础上从部门列转出4px给备注。部门仍可按三个汉字左右分行，备注获得更舒展的阅读宽度，同时保留完整姓名和等宽时间列。"},{"name":"remarks-first","widths":[67,69,63,63,97],"change":"进一步加宽备注，部门列保留48px文本宽度，争取多数部门按三字一行排列；检验长备注可读性与普通行高度之间的平衡。"},{"name":"time-headers","widths":[67,69,83,83,57],"change":"让两列时间表头各获得62px文本宽度，尝试完整单行显示；此方案用于比较清晰的表头与明显收窄的备注之间的取舍。"}]}
